analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop+Serve.swift base and head, plus the ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift patch. Serve.swift changes are small: line 289 adds startAutopilotCandidateVerification() after the idle, capacity and auto-update monitors. Lines 477-480 add shutdown of autopilotDownloadCoordinator and cancellation of autopilotCandidateVerification during teardown, before the preload cancellation wait. StartupPreload changes: canLoadMore now also checks startupPreloadStopRequested; the flag and startupPreloadCandidate are reset when the driver ends; markStartupPreloadReached records the candidate and begins a transitionGenerations .startupPreload entry. No security-boundary behavior visibly changes. Registration attestation, the App Attest resume responder (fixed process key), connection-authorization clearing, the control-event reader and the encrypted-request handling are textually unchanged, so T-053/T-057 and TB-011 control-path assumptions are preserved. The prefix-cache (T-041) surfaces are not touched.

Open integration questions are outside the supplied evidence. startAutopilotCandidateVerification, autopilotDownloadCoordinator, autopilotCandidateVerification, transitionGenerations and superviseTransitions are defined elsewhere, and their implementations were not supplied. Specifically unverified: whether autopilot candidate verification enforces weight-hash and model-identity checks (T-027, T-012) before a candidate is advertised or loaded. Also unverified: whether the shutdown ordering leaves a window where verification mutates state after coordinator shutdown, and whether a stalled startup preload that is stopped leaves a model half-loaded. No concrete regression is evidenced here. Reviewers of the autopilot download and verification files should check those points.
